Continuous TaskUpdate completed/in_progress transitions accompany each subsystem, keeping a live status of what is finished vs in-flight across the whole build.

Detects a circular/stuck state ('Find parent of respawning node') where nodes keep respawning, and changes tactics to diagnose the supervisor rather than repeating the same kill — evidence of noticing non-convergence.

Distinct verification suites per feature family (REST, WS+resilience, UI, IRC numerics, permissions/groups/pins) exercise the contract families, catching omissions; final fresh-restart run and completed status at 185 close the loop.
